## Excerpt

```markdown
# notgit

A plain directory. No git repository, no package manager, no HQ, no build
system, no dependencies. It only holds files.

It proves that TierFlow's file-snapshot style operations (read a file, run a
command with that directory as the working directory) need neither version
control nor any project metadata.

- `README.md` — this file
- `data.txt` — the payload the executor reads
```
